name: merc engineer drones castable
comment: The Space Merc Engineer's drones (the bombs that circle a player): npc/merc-engineer-drones-holder (P9TE) where the player stands, then skill/merc-engineer-drones-buff on it. The client's SpawnMonster has no NanoTemplate; 374164 is a guess (the drones buff is the only spell that circles something with the drones projectile; the Sad Clown's From Bad to Worse names its own the same way). Everything else is the client's.
